title: Travel Agents: Taiwan — Player Aid
subtitle: On your turn: do ONE action · then trim your Larder to 7

sections.heading: Do ONE action
lines: VISIT (here): flip 3 from this region's market — the event fires by scope, keep 2 ingredients (大胃王 keeps 3).
CONVENIENCE STORE (anywhere): flip 1 from any region's market — take the ingredient, or the event fires.
TRAVEL: move 1 region (HSR = 北↔南); flip 1 on arrival (event whiffs). Nudge your Followers-max dial +1. (媽寶 draws 2 from the region she LEFT; 阿嬤 reaches ANY region.)
PROMOTE (here): place 2 Followers on co-located face-up vendor(s) — public; keep your TOTAL committed Followers ≤ your Followers-max dial.

BRIBE A VENDOR (here): claim it if you hold STRICTLY MORE committed Followers than every rival (大哥 wins ties) + pay its ingredients − your region discounts. It joins your tour + may complete a Booking; your Followers return; each loser's dial drops (−1 day / −2 night).
LINE UP A BOOKING: take 1 from the face-up row, then refill. Your Bookings are your whole score (成團 completed / 取消 cancelled).
